title: 奎桑提·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 宽阔深肤体态配浓密胡须，金色耳饰呼应带有纹样的衣装。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: K'Sante is a very broad dark-skinned adult warrior with short textured hair, a strong beard, gold ear ornaments, and distinctive Nazumah-inspired patterned garments. Preserve his powerful natural proportions through a fully covering tunic, layered armor, opaque trousers, and boots. His two enormous blunt ntofo weapons stand vertically with their ends grounded beside him, recognizable as heavy broad geometric forms rather than swords.
art_direction.scene: A low viewpoint with a calm upward head turn, full iconic shape framed by a simple sweep of bright pencil hatching. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: warm brown, turquoise, gold, cobalt shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
